title: Vui lòng in nó bằng màu đen và trắng
englishTitle: Please print it in black and white
pronunciation: Vui long in no bang mau den va trang
summary: For asking a copy shop, hotel desk, or service counter to print without color.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Say it before the file is printed, especially if price or official paperwork matters.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the file, page, or sample and point to black-and-white if there is a display.

phrases.vietnamese: Vui lòng in nó bằng màu đen và trắng
phrases.english: Please print it in black and white
phrases.pronunciation: Vui long in no bang mau den va trang

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Vui lòng means please; in means print; bằng màu đen và trắng means in black and white.

breakdown.vietnamese: Vui lòng in nó bằng màu đen và trắng
breakdown.english: Please print it in black and white

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Print this, copy this, and email it phrases cover the usual copy-shop choices.

phrases.vietnamese: Anh/chị in cái này giúp tôi được không?
phrases.english: Can you print this for me?
phrases.pronunciation: Anh chi in cai nay giup toi duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể sao chép tài liệu này?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the sao chep tai lieu nay

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gửi email cho tôi được không?
phrases.english: Can you email it to me?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the gui email cho toi duoc khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at copy shops, hotel desks, reception counters, visa offices, and travel-agency desks.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Ask before they press print; color pages may cost more or be wrong for forms.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Ready time, print location, scan this, receipt, and card payment phrases cover nearby counter details.
